verdict.rationale: Plausible documents its own 'Export stats: download your data' feature and a Stats API that returns metrics as JSON, an open format. It is also FOSS and self-hostable via Community Edition, which supports leaving the hosted service. The export entry does not state the file format, and nothing shows that the export covers all data rather than aggregated stats. missing for 10: documented export file format (e.g. CSV), evidence that the export includes complete or raw event-level data, independent hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-leave migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: you can self-host it and it's FOSS
